cases.description: 12 AI engineering articles: 2 duplicate-outlet stories, 1 stale URL in seen_urls, 1 thin-snippet article.

articles.title: Google launches Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite with 40% lower latency for structured workloads
articles.snippet: Google released Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on Vertex AI and the Gemini API, cutting median latency by 40% on JSON schema extraction and high-throughput classification tasks while preserving tool-calling reliability.

articles.title: Google debuts Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite aimed at cost-sensitive multi-agent pipelines
articles.snippet: Targeting developers running high-volume agent loops, Google announced Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite with 40% faster responses for structured JSON outputs and lower per-token pricing on Vertex AI.

articles.title: Qwen3-Coder 32B arrives under Apache 2.0 with native 128K repository context
articles.snippet: The Qwen team released Qwen3-Coder 32B weights under an Apache 2.0 license, featuring 128K token context length, improved multi-file patch editing, and open evaluation scripts for SWE-bench Verified.

articles.title: Context compaction and parallel tool calls in long-horizon coding agents
articles.snippet: Anthropic engineers shared architecture patterns for keeping agent sessions reliable past 50 tool turns, highlighting structured tool-output summarization and schema-validated parallel tool execution.

articles.title: Adding deterministic verifier gates cuts citation hallucinations in agent pipelines
articles.snippet: Production teams deploying retrieval and briefing agents report that pairing structured LLM outputs with deterministic URL and schema verifiers before a critic pass catches broken links cheaply without extra judge calls.

articles.title: Google ADK 2.15 adds enhanced structured output schemas and session diagnostics
articles.snippet: Google updated Agent Development Kit to version 2.15, expanding native Pydantic output_schema support alongside tool use and introducing per-turn usage_metadata telemetry on Runner events.

articles.title: OpenAI publishes multi-step browser agent benchmark exposing form-handling gaps
articles.snippet: OpenAI released an open benchmark evaluating autonomous web agents on multi-step enterprise forms, showing strong navigation accuracy but elevated failure rates when pages mutate dynamically mid-action.

articles.title: vLLM 0.14 ships disaggregated prefill-decode scheduling to cut P99 TTFT by 35%
articles.snippet: vLLM 0.14 separates prompt prefill workers from token decode pools over RDMA KV-cache transfer, reducing 99th-percentile time-to-first-token by 35% on mixed long-context production traffic.

articles.title: New FP4 TensorRT-LLM kernels boost 70B model serving throughput by 2.1x on Blackwell
articles.snippet: NVIDIA released updated FP4 quantization kernels for TensorRT-LLM on Blackwell GPUs, delivering 2.1x higher output tokens per second on 70B-parameter models with under 0.4% accuracy drop on MMLU-Pro.

articles.title: TorchAO 0.9 introduces tree-based speculative decoding for low-batch inference
articles.snippet: PyTorch maintainers shipped TorchAO 0.9 with fused draft-model tree verification kernels, achieving 1.6x to 1.9x decode speedups at batch sizes 1 to 4 without altering output distributions.

articles.title: Frontier labs adopt shared red-teaming disclosure protocol
articles.snippet: Four major AI labs agreed on a common disclosure timeline for flaws.

articles.title: Mistral launches Enterprise Hub for on-premise model governance
articles.snippet: Mistral introduced an on-premise governance suite allowing regulated enterprises to audit prompts, manage fine-tuned model weights, and enforce role-based access policies.

cases.description: 10 non-AI clean energy and robotics articles validating domain generalization.

articles.title: Form Energy completes first commercial 100-hour iron-air battery site in Minnesota
articles.snippet: Form Energy commissioned its 10 MW / 1,000 MWh iron-air battery facility adjacent to a retiring Minnesota coal plant, marking the first utility-scale deployment of 100-hour multi-day storage on the US grid.

articles.title: European offshore wind capacity hits 41 GW as North Sea interconnectors come online
articles.snippet: Europe reached 41 gigawatts of installed offshore wind capacity following the energization of two high-voltage subsea interconnectors linking wind farms in the North Sea to grids in Germany and the UK.

articles.title: Grid batteries supplied 28% of California evening peak demand for 45 straight days
articles.snippet: California ISO operational data showed utility-scale lithium-ion storage met an average of 28% of evening net-peak electricity demand across 45 consecutive days, curbing natural gas peaker dispatch.

articles.title: MIT researchers demonstrate room-temperature solid-state sodium battery electrolyte
articles.snippet: Materials scientists at MIT synthesized a ceramic-polymer sodium electrolyte achieving ionic conductivity comparable to liquid lithium cells at room temperature without requiring cobalt or nickel.

articles.title: Fervo Energy brings 100 MW enhanced geothermal phase online in southwestern Utah
articles.snippet: Fervo Energy started commercial power delivery from the first 100 MW phase of its Cape Station enhanced geothermal project in Utah, supplying firm carbon-free baseload electricity under utility contracts.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics deploys electric Atlas humanoids in Hyundai assembly pilot
articles.snippet: Boston Dynamics began a factory pilot deploying fully electric Atlas humanoid robots to sequence heavy suspension brackets on a Hyundai automotive line, testing autonomous recovery from misaligned parts.

articles.title: Agility Robotics expands RoboFab facility to 10,000-unit annual Digit capacity
articles.snippet: Agility Robotics completed phase two of its Oregon RoboFab manufacturing plant, raising planned production capacity to 10,000 bipedal Digit warehouse robots per year alongside new logistics customer orders.

articles.title: Fanuc launches 35 kg payload vision-guided collaborative palletizer for mid-sized plants
articles.snippet: Fanuc unveiled a 35-kilogram collaborative palletizing system with integrated 3D depth vision that adapts to mixed-SKU shipping cartons without custom safety caging.

articles.title: Soft pneumatic grippers hit 98.4% grasp success on fragile fruit harvesting trials
articles.snippet: A peer-reviewed field trial reported soft silicone pneumatic grippers equipped with tactile strain sensors achieved 98.4% damage-free harvest rates on strawberries and tomatoes in commercial greenhouses.

articles.title: Autonomous subsea inspection robots complete 30-day North Atlantic cable survey
articles.snippet: A fleet of untethered autonomous underwater vehicles finished a 30-day inspection of 1,400 kilometers of North Atlantic fiber-optic subsea cables, detecting anchor-scour hazards without support vessels.

articles.title: Google Quantum AI extends below-threshold error suppression on 105-qubit chip
articles.snippet: Researchers demonstrated exponential error rate reduction as surface-code distance scaled from 3 to 7 on a 105-qubit superconducting processor, doubling logical qubit lifetime over the best physical qubit.

articles.title: TSMC begins N2 gate-all-around risk production at Baoshan fab
articles.snippet: TSMC initiated risk production on its 2-nanometer nanosheet process in Baoshan, reporting 15% lower power draw at iso-frequency compared with N3E while maintaining target defect density yields.
